name: Rizuhble's Punch Drunk Billy
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for Scourge.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Blasted T2, Chain Gang unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice. Ultimate (Chain Gang) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Shielding, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Shielding, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stalker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Have it by about 8 minutes and eat a big camp with it.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-19,200 (levels 12-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bashdown T3, Rising Ram T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Rising Ram, damage) grows from 63 to 162. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Shielding, spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Shielding completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Shielding completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases
items.legacy_note: Light punches and troopers trigger it too.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Snatch, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Bashdown counts as a punch for this.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Silencer later.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 8k weapon tier, which Point Blank completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Point Blank completes 8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bashdown (2 to 3).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bashdown (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-49,600 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Blasted T3, Chain Gang T3.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it when you chain them in.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Bullet Resist Shredder for this.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Cast it on yourself as you dive in.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Spirit Shielding? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Spirit Shielding? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you on the way in.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Bashdown (channelled) and Rising Ram (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you before you reach them.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They kite you and the ram keeps missing.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
